parks.name: Cataloochee Valley
parks.blurb: Elk grazing in mountain meadows, plus black bears, wild turkeys and groundhogs.

parks.name: Great Smoky Mountains (Oconaluftee & Deep Creek)
parks.blurb: Elk by the visitor center, salamanders found nowhere else, bears and mountain streams.

parks.name: Clingmans Dome & Heintooga Ridge
parks.blurb: High spruce-fir forest where red-cheeked salamanders come out on wet nights.

parks.name: Blue Ridge Parkway near Asheville
parks.blurb: Overlooks with fall monarch migration, groundhogs, turkeys and black bears.

parks.name: Grandfather Mountain & Linville Gorge
parks.blurb: Rugged peaks with chipmunks, ravens, red efts and rushing trout streams.

parks.name: DuPont State Forest & Pisgah
parks.blurb: Waterfalls, brook trout streams, salamanders and swallowtails.

parks.name: Hanging Rock & Pilot Mountain
parks.blurb: Piedmont monadnocks with fence lizards, chipmunks, hawks and spring wildflowers.

parks.name: Umstead State Park & Raleigh greenways
parks.blurb: Big city park forests with barred owls, pileated woodpeckers, deer and beavers.

parks.name: Eno River & Durham
parks.blurb: River trails with zebra swallowtails, beavers, turtles and woodland birds.

parks.name: Chapel Hill & NC Botanical Garden
parks.blurb: Campus squirrels, garden butterflies, hummingbirds and Mason Farm's wetlands.

parks.name: Jordan Lake
parks.blurb: North Carolina's bald eagle hotspot, with ospreys, herons and turtles.

parks.name: Charlotte & McDowell Nature Preserve
parks.blurb: City and lakeside wildlife: joro spiders, herons, deer and backyard birds.

parks.name: Weymouth Woods & the Sandhills
parks.blurb: Longleaf pines with red-cockaded woodpeckers, fox squirrels and Pine Barrens treefrogs.

parks.name: Merchants Millpond State Park
parks.blurb: A blackwater swamp of cypress and tupelo with prothonotary warblers, otters and turtles.

parks.name: Lake Mattamuskeet
parks.blurb: Tens of thousands of tundra swans and ducks in winter, plus bald eagles and alligators.

parks.name: Alligator River & Pocosin Lakes
parks.blurb: Home of the world's only wild red wolves, plus black bears, alligators and swans.

parks.name: Nags Head & Jockey's Ridge
parks.blurb: Dunes, sound-side marsh and piers with dolphins, pelicans and ghost crabs.

parks.name: Pea Island National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Barrier island ponds full of herons, egrets, swans, terns and shorebirds.

parks.name: Cape Hatteras & Ocracoke
parks.blurb: Cape Point's surf fishing, sea turtle nests, skimmers and storm-tossed shells.

parks.name: Beaufort, Shackleford Banks & Cape Lookout
parks.blurb: Wild horses, oystercatchers, dolphins, fiddler crabs and the Rachel Carson Reserve.

parks.name: Croatan National Forest
parks.blurb: Pine savannas and pocosins with red-cockaded woodpeckers, alligators and carnivorous plants.

parks.name: Wilmington & Greenfield Lake
parks.blurb: Alligators, herons, egrets, anoles and painted buntings in town.

parks.name: Carolina Beach & Fort Fisher
parks.blurb: Painted buntings, terrapins, ghost crabs, ibises and lubber grasshoppers.

parks.name: Lake Waccamaw & Green Swamp
parks.blurb: Cypress-lined lake with alligators, prothonotary warblers, and pine savanna wildlife.
